description: add_business_days(start, n, holidays) returns the date that is n business days after start (a datetime.date). holidays is a set of dates. Business days are Monday to Friday that are not in holidays. The start date itself is never counted, and it does not have to be a business day. A negative n moves backwards in time by that many business days. n = 0 returns start unchanged, even if start is a weekend or a holiday. Holidays that fall on a weekend change nothing.
